Messi and Mbappé vie for Golden Boot in World Cup final

The race for the FIFA World Cup Golden Boot is intensifying ahead of the final. Kylian Mbappé of France currently leads with 10 goals, while Lionel Messi of Argentina has scored 8. The outcome will be decided in the final match, with Messi needing to overcome a two-goal deficit.
